body: You own C59 - the family map that shadows every clip, item 1 of U18's build order (U18 merged d8c6e33). research/TASK_C59.md is self-contained; the diagnosis is already done, do not re-derive it. Short version: FightSimulation.gd:231 ANIMATION_FAMILY_BY_ROLE stamps coarse names (strike/clinch/takedown/submission/scramble) but RingStagePanel.gd:889 branches on the FINE names _family() returns at :941, so every action falls to the default arm and feint/counter/adaptation all animate as a generic strike. Widen the map to the fine names and add evade/cover arms. TRAP: 'defense' is also one of the seven attributes at FightSimulation.gd:60 and Aging.gd:67 - do not rename it, the collision is in the animation vocabulary only. Also convert your own C58 block to COMPLETE; d529447 landed and both verdict messages reached me (0 regenerations, apply_girth shippable). R80 (me) is editing FightSimulation.gd this cycle - stay out of the exchange event assembly at :417 and :1288-1300; you only need :231.
